title: Acquirer: MM Kembla Copper Systems; Target: McKechnie Metals Pty Ltd

body_sections.Summary: MM Kembla New Zealand Limited proposes to acquire the MCK Metals plumbing tube business in Australia and New Zealand.
body_sections.Market definition: The relevant market was found to be the national market for plumbing tube.
body_sections.Competition analysis: It appears that the proposed acquisition would not lead to a substantial lessening of competition in the national market for supply of plumbing tube for the following reasons: - local and imported plastic plumbing tube appears to be a substitute for copper tube and has taken market share from copper tube for several years; - sustained and significant levels of copper and plastic tube imports independent of the parties appear to exercise a strong competitive constraint on the market, with a market share of approximately 20 per cent; - substantial competitors in Australia and overseas face few constraints in increasing production or imports respectively; and - four organised, large and well informed customers account for 90 per cent of sales of plumbing tube in Australia.
